{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Knowing Skull
| Image = Event-KnowingSkull.png
}}
{{E|Knowing Skull}} is a {{QueryLink|Events|shrine:Yes|shrine Event}} found exclusively in [[Act 2]]. It will only appear if the player has at least 13 HP; guaranteeing they can select at least 1 option and leave the event without dying.

== Options ==
The following options are presented to the player until they decide to leave the event. X is equal to 10% of the player's Max HP (minimum of 6 HP) plus the number of times they have chosen that specific option ({{TS|negative||Lose 6 HP}}, then {{TS|negative||Lose 7 HP}}, then {{TS|negative||Lose 8 HP}}, etc.)
<br>
<br>
{{Frame|A Pick Me Up?}} {{TS|positive||Get a [[Potion]].}} {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}} 
* A random [[Potion]] is immediately added to the player's left-most empty potion slot.
* The player is able to select this option even if all their potion slots are full or if they possess {{R|Sozu}}. They still lose HP and this option's HP loss is still increased by 1 even though no potion is obtained.

{{Frame|Riches?}} {{TS|positive||Gain 90 [[Gold]].}} {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}}
<br>
<br>
{{Frame|Success?}} {{TS|positive||Get a}} {{QueryLink|Cards|color:Colorless|Colorless card}}. {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}}
* A random {{QueryLink|Cards|rarity:Uncommon&color:Colorless|Uncommon Colorless card}} is added to the player's deck.

{{Frame|How do I leave?}} {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}}
* This event repeats until this option is chosen.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote>
<div style="font-style:italic">You find yourself in an old, decorated chamber. In the center of the room, a large skull sits atop an ornate pedestal. As you approach, the skull {{TS|green|shake|bursts into flames}} and turns to face you.</div>
<br>
<br>
{{Frame|Continue}}
<br>
<br>
<div style="font-style:italic">"WHAT IS IT YOU SEEK? WHAT IS IT YOU OFFER?" <br>
In sync with its final words, the door behind you {{TS||shake|slams shut.}}</div>
<br><br>
{{Frame|A Pick Me Up?}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"DRINK UP!" <br>
You obtain a potion. <br>

"ANYTHING ELSE?"
</div>

The player is able to choose any of the [[#Options|Options]] again. {{Frame|A Pick Me Up?}} now costs 1 more HP than it did previously.
</blockquote>


{{Frame|Riches?}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"YOU MORTALS NEVER CHANGE. IT IS DONE." <br>
{{TS|gold||Gold}} rains down on you! <br>

"ANYTHING ELSE?"
</div>

The player is able to choose any of the [[#Options|Options]] again. {{Frame|Riches?}} now costs 1 more HP than it did previously.
</blockquote>

{{Frame|Success?}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"PERHAPS THIS WILL HELP?"

You obtain a card.

"ANYTHING ELSE?"
</div>

The player is able to choose any of the [[#Options|Options]] again. {{Frame|Success?}} now costs 1 more HP than it did previously.
</blockquote>

{{Frame|How do I leave?}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"BEHIND YOU, MORTAL." <br>
You peek behind the skull. Surely enough, there is a door.
</div>

The event ends, and the player is given the option to {{Frame|Leave}}.
</blockquote>

</blockquote>

== Notes ==
* {{R|Bloody Idol}} can greatly increase the number of times the player can choose {{Frame|Riches?}} since they will heal 5 HP every time it gives them [[Gold]].
* {{R|Tungsten Rod}} will reduce the HP lost by 1 every time an option is selected.

== Update History ==
* '''Patch V2.0: The Watcher'''
** Knowing Skull event HP cost increases with each reward taken.

* '''Patch V1.1: The Dealer'''
** Knowing Skull event can no longer give you a potion if you have the Sozu relic.

* '''Weekly Patch 40: Forethought'''
** Events: Falling, Secret Portal, Knowing Skull, Golden Idol, and Scrap Ooze receive ambient BGM.

* '''Weekly Patch 32: Face Trader'''
** Knowing Skull HP cost minimum is set to 6 to prevent infinite gold with Bloody Idol.

* '''Weekly Patch 30: Skewer'''
** Knowing Skull event now always asks for 10% of your Max HP instead of a set amount.

* '''Weekly Patch 5: Happy Holidays!'''
** Knowing Skull event gets reworked. Die to your greed now.

* '''Weekly Patch 3: Balance Balance Balance'''
** Fixed Knowing Skull event options being ordered oddly after choosing the top option twice.
